_internalReasoning: Extracted all beverages from the Cafe Crisn menu, grouped by sugar and calorie profile following nutritional and diet rules.
summary: Beverages on this menu range from unsweetened tea and plain coconut water to extremely high-sugar milk and syrup-based dessert drinks. Opt for plain tea or fresh coconut water to minimize glycemic impact.

groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Plain Teas & Coconut Water
groups.comparisonSentence: These plain teas, ginger infusions, black coffee, and fresh coconut water contain minimal added sugars compared to the heavily sweetened fruit juices and dessert bowls.
groups.message: These selections provide hydration and natural electrolytes with negligible added sugars and calories. They are ideal for maintaining stable blood glucose and avoiding unnecessary liquid empty calories.
groups.orderingTip: Request with no added sugar or syrup where applicable.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Fresh Fruit Juices
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike plain teas, these whole fruit juices deliver beneficial vitamins and fiber but introduce higher levels of natural fruit sugars and calories.
groups.message: Fresh fruit juices offer valuable micronutrients and antioxidants, though the liquefaction of fruit breaks down cellular walls and accelerates fructose absorption into the bloodstream.
groups.orderingTip: Ask for no added simple syrup or condensed milk in your juice.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution Choice: Flavored Jellies & Syrups
groups.comparisonSentence: These flavored mojitos, yakult drinks, and jelly sodas contain significantly higher amounts of refined syrups and artificial additives than pure fruit juices.
groups.message: These specialty beverages combine flavored syrups, carbonated soda, and sugary jellies, which substantially increase glycemic load and chemical additive intake without providing meaningful nutritional benefits.
groups.orderingTip: Request half syrup or skip the flavored jellies to reduce sugar.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert Choice: Heavy Dessert Drinks & Condensed Milk

verdict.label: High Sugar and Calorie Dessert Load

groups.comparisonSentence: These rich dessert beverages and mixed fruit soups pack excessive saturated fats and condensed milk sugars, far exceeding the caloric density of simple teas or plain juices.
groups.message: Containing heavy layers of condensed milk, coconut cream, and multiple sweetened toppings, these items pose severe metabolic loads, contributing to rapid blood sugar spikes and elevated caloric surplus.
groups.orderingTip: Treat these as an occasional dessert rather than a standard beverage accompaniment.
